title: Gross sales
content: Gross sales sum quantity multiplied by unit price for completed order items before discounts or refunds.

title: Net sales
content: Net sales are gross sales minus order-level discounts and refunds, each deducted once.

title: Average order value
content: AOV is net sales divided by the count of completed orders. Return N/A if there are no completed orders.

title: Eligible orders
content: Completed orders are eligible, even when partially or fully refunded; cancelled and failed orders are excluded.

title: Cancelled orders
content: Cancelled orders are not included in gross sales, net sales, order counts or product rankings.

title: Failed orders
content: Failed orders are excluded from sales calculations and eligible order counts.

title: Refund treatment
content: Refunds reduce net sales but do not remove a completed order from eligible order counts.

title: Partial refund
content: A partial refund subtracts only its refunded amount from net sales.

title: Full refund
content: A full refund can reduce an order net amount to zero without changing completed-order eligibility.

title: Discount treatment
content: Order-level discounts reduce net sales once per order, not once per item.

title: Gross item revenue
content: Product gross item revenue sums quantity times unit price across completed order items.

title: Units sold
content: Units sold sum item quantities from completed orders for each product.

title: Product rankings by units
content: Rank products by summed units sold and explicitly state the metric and date range.

title: Product rankings by revenue
content: Rank products by gross item revenue, before order-level discounts and refunds.

title: Refund allocation
content: This prototype does not allocate order-level refunds to individual products.

title: Daily reporting
content: Daily reports group completed orders by the order timestamp calendar date.

title: Reporting period
content: Specify start and end dates when requesting product rankings over a date range.

title: Zero order days
content: A day without completed orders has zero gross and net sales and an unavailable AOV.

title: Order identifier
content: order_id uniquely identifies an order and links its line items.

title: Item identifier
content: item_id uniquely identifies a POS line item.

title: Product identifier
content: product_id identifies a catalog product referenced by order items.

title: Foreign keys
content: Each order item must reference an existing order and product.

title: Duplicate identifiers
content: Repeated primary keys are invalid and must be flagged rather than silently aggregated.

title: Missing timestamps
content: An order with a missing or invalid timestamp cannot be assigned to a reporting date.

title: Invalid quantities
content: Completed-sale item quantities must be positive to support valid unit and revenue totals.

title: Invalid prices
content: Unit prices cannot be negative; invalid rows should be quarantined.

title: Financial reconciliation
content: Discounts and refunds cannot jointly exceed the completed order gross amount.

title: Order status
content: Supported order statuses are completed, cancelled and failed.

title: Data provenance
content: BizAssist uses generated synthetic POS records, not live store transactions.

title: Privacy
content: Synthetic records do not contain real customer identities or payment card data.

title: Data validation
content: Validate required columns, types, keys, values and financial totals before analytics.

title: Rejected records
content: Quarantined records retain a reason for rejection and are excluded from calculations.

title: Categorical encoding
content: One-hot encoding converts order status and product category into numeric indicator columns.

title: Numerical scaling
content: Standardization centers numerical analysis features and scales by training-set standard deviation.

title: Day of week
content: day_of_week derives from an order timestamp and can reveal weekly demand patterns.

title: Hour of day
content: hour_of_day derives from an order timestamp and can reveal time-of-day demand patterns.

title: Knowledge retrieval
content: FAQ documents are retrieved using text similarity and reported with source IDs.

title: Retrieval uncertainty
content: Weakly matched knowledge questions should receive a limitation instead of a fabricated answer.

title: No forecasting
content: The prototype reports historical synthetic sales and does not predict future profits.

title: No payment processing
content: The prototype cannot process card payments, payroll or tax filings.
